SELECT b46t.a,
    b46u.b,
    ( SELECT max(x.a) AS max
           FROM b46t x
          WHERE (x.a = b46t.a)) AS mx,
        CASE
            WHEN (b46t.a > 1) THEN 'big'::text
            ELSE 'small'::text
        END AS sz
   FROM b46t,
    b46u
  WHERE (b46t.a = b46u.a);
